title: Web Notification & Service Worker Testing — SW Lifecycle + Push Simulator
title_es: Casos de Prueba de Notificaciones Web y Service Worker — Simulador de lifecycle del SW + push
description: A stdlib Python model of the service worker lifecycle (register, install, precache, waiting/skipWaiting, cache purge, opt-out) plus a real sw.js fixture for the Playwright/CDP spec in the article. Pytest suite maps 1:1 to the TC ids.
description_es: Modelo stdlib en Python del ciclo de vida del service worker (registro, install, precache, waiting/skipWaiting, purga de caché, opt-out) más un fixture sw.js real para la spec de Playwright/CDP del artículo. La suite de pytest mapea 1:1 a los TC.
